about: 40 emotes played on the Roblox avatar; each player picks 8 for their emote wheel (B) in the Locker. unlock: default = everyone has it (the first 7); obby = finish the obby; victory = win a Victory Royale; kills = lifetime eliminations reach 'need' (150 unlocks the last one); wins = Victory Royales reach 'need'; range = score 'need' in one shooting-range round (match.rangeRoundSeconds); bullseyes = hit 'need' bullseyes at the range in all. Fairer since test9 (creator): nothing needs more than 150 kills or 8 wins, and the range unlocks only took over items that needed 100+ kills, so nobody lost one. Each loops over 'loopSeconds' through its keyframes (emote_keys). v2.0.0: shop = bought in the Locker's shop for gold; need is the price. props (2.0.0-test5): things the emote brings out while it plays, "model@where, ..." (fabric/tools/blender/props.py; - for none; "model@where/n" spins it n times a loop round its own up-and-down line, 2.0.0-test6: the lasso): @ground in the avatar's own space, @body the upper body's, @head the head's, @right_hand / @left_hand a hand's, following the forearm. music: the sounds-sheet row of the emote's own music (2.0.0-test5: fabric/tools/audio/emote_music.py), looping while it's danced: the dancer hears it and their own game music goes quiet till they stop; everyone near hears it coming from them, over their own music.

rows.name: Wave
rows.note: right arm up and out, the forearm swinging side to side from the elbow, in line and then upright beside the head

rows.name: Arm Swing
rows.note: both arms swing side to side, elbows easing, dipping in the middle

rows.name: Robot
rows.note: stiff, snapping 90 degree elbows with holds

rows.name: Floss
rows.note: arms swing right across the body, front and back in turn, hips the other way

rows.name: Dab
rows.note: a wind-up, then the dab snapped and held: one arm out and up, the face in the other's elbow

rows.name: Jumping Jacks
rows.note: arms up and legs out, then back, hopping with bent knees

rows.name: Twist
rows.note: the body twists left and right, bent arms, knees low and bouncing

rows.name: Obby Hop
rows.note: crouch, a big parkour hop with knees tucked and arms swinging, a soft landing

rows.name: Victory Dance
rows.note: arms up in a V, pumping from the elbows, bouncing, looking up

rows.name: Clap
rows.note: hands clapping together in front of the chest and apart again, smoothly, with a little nod and bounce

rows.name: Salute
rows.note: the fingertips snapped up to the right brow, elbow out, chest up, held, then away

rows.name: Shrug
rows.note: elbows in, forearms out, palms up, shoulders up, head tilted

rows.name: Chicken Dance
rows.note: hands tucked up in front of the shoulders, elbows flapping, pecking head, knees up in turns

rows.name: Disco Point
rows.note: point up high, then right down across to the other hip and back up, the other hand on the hip, hips swinging

rows.name: Running Man
rows.note: running on the spot, knees high, arms pumping with bent elbows

rows.name: Karate Chop
rows.note: a crouch, a jumping chop: the hand high, landing in a wide stance with the chop down in front, the other fist at the hip

rows.name: Air Guitar
rows.note: the left hand out on the neck, the right forearm across the body strumming, head banging, rocking on bent knees

rows.name: Drum Solo
rows.note: at a drum kit with sticks: beats on the snare and hi-hat, a roll round the toms, a crash

rows.name: Boxing
rows.note: guard up, jab, cross with the hips behind it, jab, light on bent knees

rows.name: Spin
rows.note: a full turn with arms out

rows.name: Helicopter
rows.note: arms out, spinning fast, lifting off, knees tucking

rows.name: Hip Shake
rows.note: hands on the hips, hips side to side

rows.name: Swim
rows.note: front crawl in the air: reach, pull, push past the hip, the elbow high coming over, turning to breathe

rows.name: Zombie Walk
rows.note: arms out, head lolling, shuffling on dragging knees

rows.name: Flex
rows.note: double biceps, a pulse, a side flex, double biceps: just flexing

rows.name: Bow
rows.note: a hand across the waist, the other back, a polite bow

rows.name: Cheer
rows.note: fists up in turns, bouncing on bent knees

rows.name: Raise the Roof
rows.note: palms up overhead, pumping the arms straight up and down, jumping on each push

rows.name: Penguin Waddle
rows.note: little flaps and a waddle, stiff as a penguin

rows.name: Smooth Slide
rows.note: a foot steps out to the side, the other drags along the floor to it, twice, then back the other way

rows.name: Hero Fly
rows.note: one fist up, the other at the hip, hovering

rows.name: Star Jump
rows.note: crouch, a big jumping star, land on bent knees

rows.name: Hula
rows.note: hands on the hips, the hips circling round and round, shoulders level

rows.name: Double Wave
rows.note: both arms up and out, the forearms swinging side to side from the elbows, swaying

rows.name: Rock Out
rows.note: strumming hard on the guitar, the left hand on its neck, head banging; then the arm thrown up high and brought down in a big sweep onto the strings

rows.name: Tap Dance
rows.note: quick feet with bending knees, arms out for balance

rows.name: Lasso Twirl
rows.note: a rope twirled overhead, the other hand on the hip

rows.name: Breakdance Spin
rows.note: a headspin: upside down on its head, legs in a V

rows.name: Wave Ripple
rows.note: the arm wave: a ripple running from one hand up the arm, across the shoulders and out to the other hand, and back

rows.name: Legendary Royale
rows.note: the 1000-kill emote: crouch, a spinning jump with knees tucked, land, victory pose

rows.name: Griddy
rows.note: heels tapped out in front in turn, arms swinging, then both hands up round the eyes like goggles

rows.name: Default Dance
rows.note: arms swung side to side on a bounce, pumped up and down, then a kick back

rows.name: Orange Justice
rows.note: knees bent and bouncing, both arms swinging together side to side across the front, a foot kicking out sideways in turn

rows.name: Boneless
rows.note: going limp, dropping to the floor and flopping about on it like there are no bones, then back up

rows.name: Take the L
rows.note: an L on the forehead, legs kicked out to the sides in turn

rows.name: Electro Shuffle
rows.note: feet shuffling out to the sides, forearms pumping in front in turn

rows.name: Fresh
rows.note: the Carlton: arms swinging together side to side at the waist, the hips the other way, then a step and a snap with a head turn

rows.name: Hype
rows.note: fists thrust up overhead in turn, knees pumping
